notes: Identity independently checked against supplied reference: title A Replication and Extension of the PEERS Intervention: Examining Effects on Social Skills and Social Anxiety in Adolescents with Autism Spectrum Disorders; Schohl, Van Hecke, Carson, Dolan, Karst, Stevens; DOI 10.1007/s10803-013-1900-1; marked ORIGINAL PAPER, Springer 2013. Supplied text contains abstract, methods, results, discussion, tables, and references, consistent with a full primary research report, not an abstract or secondary account. No PDF was supplied, so layout was assessed only from canonical text and form-feed pages. Original and replication n are unassigned placeholders. Table 3 provides pre/post group means and SD and interaction p labelled ns. No numeric effect/test statistic or numeric p for the FQS interaction is printed in the inspected Results or Table 3. Means and SD are not converted to an effect size; ns is retained as evidence, not converted into a numeric p bound. Reported success is coded at the assigned outcome level from authors’ narrative, rather than the paper-wide positive conclusion.
